messages:
ben: heads up — dashboard spike on token usage for acct org-42 right after we flipped shadow routing yesterday. appears to double count some streaming tokens. anyone else seeing this?
carla: I saw the spike too. timeline matches when shadow routing to small-quantized model was enabled for canary traffic. :thinking_face: 
alice: more details from the console? which route? metric name?
ben: route=generate.v1, policy=shadow->fallback. Console shows +13% tokens for sample day vs baseline. invoices table shows mismatch between metering events and invoice_tokens.
dan: maybe streaming flush/partial events were emitted twice — once on forward then again on fallback. did we change the replay dedupe window?
metering-bot: alert: invoice_tokens != sum(metered_tokens) for org-42 on 2024-06-03 (delta=+120k tokens)
maria: adding logs — here's truncated proxy trace where request is proxied to primary and then replayed to fallback
ben: ```
[2024-06-03T14:02:01.123Z] req_id=abc123 route=generate.v1 -> model=redwood-large
[2024-06-03T14:02:01.456Z] req_id=abc123 fallback_attempt model=redwood-small
[2024-06-03T14:02:01.789Z] stream_chunk tokens=64
[2024-06-03T14:02:02.000Z] stream_chunk tokens=32
``` 
carla: aha — the proxy emits stream_chunk events for both attempts, and our metering worker dedupes by req_id only at ingest level, but dedupe window is 5s and replay occurs within that window so should dedupe — but looks like the fallback uses a new req_id sometimes due to router rewriting
alice: router rewrite? that's the routing session id header change we rolled last week
ben: yes, router appends session_suffix when policy=shadow, we didn't propagate original_req_id into fallback request in all cases
dan: so metering sees two distinct req_ids and counts both streams
maria: proposed fixes: 1) ensure router preserves x-original-req-id on fallback; 2) update metering dedupe to check parent_session header; 3) emit a 'fallback_marker' event so invoices can reconcile
carla: prefer 1+3, 2 is risky and large-scope
alice: also need console UX: show 'shadowed' badge on per-route token breakdown and a reconciliation column 'deduped_by' so billing team can see corrections
ben: timeline? we need a hotfix to stop new double-counting today
dan: ok i'll open a quick PR to set x-original-req-id in the router for any fallback/shadow path. can someone review fast?
maria: I'll take the metering side for a reconciliation job to backfill dedupe by matching timestamps + model variant
metering-bot: task created: MET-842 reconcile org-42 delta +120k tokens
infra-bot: deploy scheduled for router hotfix canary at 15:30 UTC
carla: postmortem note: rollout UX needs an explicit "preserve-request-id" toggle when enabling shadowing. ticket UX-132
ben: thanks everyone — assign owners and I'll track with finance for invoice adjustments :thumbsup: 
alice: assign owners: router=dan, metering=maria, console=carla, finance=lina
lina: (added) acknowledging — will hold invoice adjustments until MET-842 backfill completes
ben: cool. will follow up in #incidents if the delta grows
